remarks: Welcome to a truly one-of-a-kind property where nature, versatility, and location come together. Nestled in a highly desirable neighborhood on nearly 2 acres! This incredible property offers a 3-bedroom, 1-bath main home plus a separate 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment above the garage. Currently unoccupied, the apartment is ideal as an in-law suite, guest quarters, or income-producing Airbnb. According to AirDNA, the average Airbnb in Orchard Park earns approximately $252 per night, creating an exciting income opportunity. Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, and business owners will appreciate the impressive 5-car garage featuring 11.5-foot garage doors on three bays—perfect for storing a camper, RV, boat, or large equipment. With exceptional ceiling height, there's plenty of room for a vehicle lift...or even three! The grounds create a private retreat reminiscent of a botanical garden, showcasing dawn redwood, oak, birch, and dogwood trees, butterfly and hummingbird host plants, beautiful spring blooms, an inground pool, peaceful pond with a windmill aerator, and a chicken coop with attached run. Inside, the main home features soaring cathedral ceilings in the living room, a formal dining room, breakfast nook, and a full basement with poured concrete walls. Upstairs, in addition to the three bedrooms, a bonus room offers the opportunity to create a luxurious primary suite by adding a master bath. Additional highlights include a new septic system (2020), a large driveway with abundant parking, and endless possibilities. Located just 3 miles from both the Village of Orchard Park and the Village of East Aurora, you'll enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, and community events. Nearby are Knox Farm State Park, several golf courses, Kissing Bridge, Buffalo Ski Center, the new Buffalo Bills Stadium (6 miles), and Blueberry Treehouse Farm (5 miles). Offering an unbeatable combination of space, beauty, versatility, and location, this remarkable property is a rare opportunity to own a home that truly has it all. Also listed as Single-Family B1697965. Online estate sale starts 7.20 and ends 8.3 via Southtowns Auctions LLC.
facts: Garage, Paved, Two Or More Spaces
